items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I remember first Professor Mineta told us that he was a very delicate eater

ctx.x: Yes, 7 o'clock, he had to make us go at the market, go at the grocery, bring everything home for his breakfast when he go in his evening. It's time to come out again.

I remember first Professor Mineta told us that he was a very delicate eater, I mean, not delicate, but he liked his food just right, you know. I guess that's what he did, he got his food from the market first thing in the market.
Well, yes, he ate, he didn't know how to cook for him.
